# specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md

```markdown
# SEC filing ingestion — Roadmap

> For agentic workers: REQUIRED SKILL: derive-roadmap — resume via its
> reconcile step; route each unticked stage per its ROUTING line; never plan
> this document wholesale.

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md, specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md.
Choices made: Python 3.14 (from `.python-version`). uv workspace with four package scaffolds (from the root `pyproject.toml`).

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes at 3 req/s (SEC full-index and daily-index directories); measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks for full history at 3 req/s (index row count × request rate; not yet measured); one quarter measured by Stage 2 |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 3 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression). One track: each outcome consumes the one before it.

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Index ingestion core
      Objective: Ingest the SEC's real quarterly and daily master indexes into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: a filing-index table covering the full-index archive and the open quarter's daily indexes; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: the table holds rows from every quarterly master index in the full-index archive plus the open quarter's daily indexes, with rows that overlap between quarterly and daily sources appearing once; the findings file records wall time, bytes downloaded, row count and observed SEC request rate of the real run
      Leaves out: retained raw snapshots, source manifest and replay (Stage 4); quarterly reconciliation, withdrawals and versioned per-quarter publication (Stage 5); full validation suite on historical formats (Stage 7); scheduling, catch-up, shared request budget and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submissions download, one quarter
      Objective: Download the submissions that one closed quarter's index rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table
      Produces: one closed quarter's submissions on disk, each traceable to its index row; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: every submission named by the chosen quarter's index rows is on disk or listed as a named failure; the findings file records file count, bytes, wall time, observed request rate and the projected full-history download time
      Leaves out: full-history download (Stage 6); retained snapshots and manifest (Stage 4); validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling, one quarter
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of Stage 2's quarter and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloaded quarter
      Produces: extracted main documents for that quarter's 10-K and 8-K filings; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: each 10-K and 8-K in the quarter has its main document extracted or is listed as a named failure; the findings file records filing counts, failure count by reason and wall time
      Leaves out: full-history extraction (Stage 6); replay from retained bytes (Stage 4); validation suite (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Provenance and replay
      Objective: Retain original bytes with a source manifest so outputs can be traced and rebuilt without re-downloading.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–3 outputs
      Produces: retained raw snapshots and a source manifest for indexes and submissions; replay from retained bytes
      Exit: every index row and extracted document traces to its source file and content hash; rebuilding the index table and the Stage 3 extracts after a parser change issues zero SEC requests
      Leaves out: reconciliation and versioned publication (Stage 5); validation suite (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Index reconciliation and versioned publication
      Objective: Reconcile re-read quarterly indexes against the table and publish complete per-quarter versions (background: spec §4.4, §4.6).
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifest and content hashes
      Produces: per-quarter published versions with change records; a reader contract naming the active version
      Exit: re-reading a changed quarterly index records its additions and field changes; a removal takes effect only after explicit approval; readers see only complete quarter versions and can name the version they read
      Leaves out: scheduled reconciliation runs (Stage 8); validation suite (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full-history submissions and filings
      Objective: Download all submissions the index names and extract every 10-K and 8-K main document, resumably.
      Outcomes: O2, O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloader and Stage 3's extraction; Stage 4's manifest for checkpoints; Stage 2's findings for the projected duration
      Produces: full-history submissions and 10-K/8-K extracts, with a per-quarter completion report
      Exit: the completion report lists every quarter as complete or with named gaps; an interrupted run resumes without re-downloading completed files
      Leaves out: scheduled ongoing download of new submissions (Stage 8); validation suite (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Validation suite
      Objective: Cover the pipeline in CI with committed fixtures and mocked SEC responses.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–6
      Produces: a CI suite that makes no SEC requests
      Exit: CI passes on fixtures covering the historical index formats in the ingested range, malformed and HTML responses, throttling and retry handling, interrupted-run resume, and the Stage 5 approval gate
      Leaves out: deployment integration tests (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 8: Scheduled operation and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and weekly reconciliation on a chosen platform under one shared SEC request budget (platform per the ADR, status Proposed, decided in this stage).
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–7
      Produces: deployed scheduled pipelines, monitoring and alerts
      Exit: observed scheduled runs ingest new daily indexes and their submissions, a missed run catches up without losing older work, concurrent runs share one request budget, and a failed run raises an alert
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

## Stage-spec stamp

Every stage spec's Rollout note carries this line, which writing-plans copies verbatim into the stage plan's header:

> Roadmap: specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md, Stage N — on plan completion, tick the stage and re-validate later stages against what shipped.

## Completion

When every stage is ticked, run derive-roadmap §6 over the Outcomes list (O1–O3): one verdict per outcome with evidence (implementing stage and plan, Deviation notes, deferred_items entries). An unmet outcome exits as a new stage or a written deferral.
```

Stages 1–3 follow your order and stages 4–8 add the hardening, with full-history submissions (6) after provenance (4) because a weeks-long download needs resumable checkpoints first. Do you approve this partition, or want to amend it, before Stage 1?
